task: Making stuffed dates with goat cheese and almonds
query: How do I make stuffed dates with goat cheese and almonds?

goal.title: Prepare stuffed dates with white filling and sliced nuts
goal.description: Open six dates by hand, spoon white filling into their cavities, transfer them to a plate and press sliced nuts into the filling.
goal.final_state: Six dates containing white filling and pale sliced-nut toppings remain arranged on a plate; both hands withdraw.

procedure.description: Open the upper cupboard and take out the orange date bag. Pull its opening apart and remove dates one at a time, placing six on the cutting board. Press the bag closed.

Set the bag on the counter, retrieve the hanging dark cloth and wipe the work surface. Return the cloth to its hook. Turn on the faucet, rub both hands under running water, turn the faucet off and dry hands on a hanging towel.

Return to the board and pick up each date in turn. Pull the sides apart with fingers to widen its opening, then place it back on the board. Repeat until six opened dates are aligned in a row. Removal of individual pits is not clearly visible.

Open the utensil drawer, lift a spoon with the left hand and pass it to the right. Scoop white soft filling from an already-open foil wrapper, pick up the first opened date in the left hand and repeatedly spread filling into its cavity. Put the filled date and spoon down.
Leave the kitchen counter and walk into the adjoining room. Press a wall switch; the ceiling light illuminates. Walk back to the dates and retrieve the spoon.

Load the spoon repeatedly from the white filling in its foil wrapper. Pick up the next date with the left hand, spread filling into it and replace it on the board. Repeat for the remaining dates; one date is pulled wider with the left fingers before filling. Finish filling the last date while still holding it.
Return the spoon to the foil wrapper. Use both hands to carry two filled dates to the nearby plate, then transfer the others singly and in a final pair. Adjust the six dates on the plate.

Pick up pale nut slices from the plate with the right fingertips. Hold each date steady with the left hand while pressing slices into the exposed white filling. Repeat across the dates, adjust the arrangement and release the food. The video ends with six garnished dates on the plate; no eating is shown.
